scripts.dev: npm run build -w @librarium/shared && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @librarium/api" "npm run dev -w @librarium/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @librarium/shared && npm run build -w @librarium/web && npm run build -w @librarium/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @librarium/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
